answer: Each extra alias then needs its own bond, its own jade record, and its own share of the canyon quota, which is where the cost multiplies. The atlas ledger enforces the limit at intake. The nonce chain allows at most 2 challenge submissions per identity per epoch, which means extra aliases are the only way to submit more. A farm of 1512 identities would post 1148 proofs and burn roughly 64 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
